text:
Rocky Mount ties for 68th among Virginia cities in June scam reports
T. N. Doss
Rocky Mount was one of 98 cities tied for 68th among 165 Virginia cities with at least one BBB Scam Tracker report in June 2026, based on one report, according to Better Business Bureau.
The city recorded the same number of reports as the previous month.
The report listed a $100 loss from an online purchase scam that described an attempt to sell gift cards for cash.
BBB Scam Tracker lets consumers search reported scams and share their own experiences to help others recognize similar schemes. The BBB says it reviews each report before publication and does not publicly display the reporter’s name or personal contact information.
Fraud reports have continued to carry large financial losses nationwide. The Federal Trade Commission said consumers reported losing more than $12.5 billion to fraud in 2024, a 25% increase from the previous year.
